## Datasets — papers used in the pipeline

Daneman R, Zhou L, Agalliu D, Cahoy JD, Kaushal A, Barres BA (2010).
The mouse blood–brain barrier transcriptome: a new resource for understanding the development
and function of brain endothelial cells. *PLOS ONE* 5(10): e13741.
: Mouse BBB gene list — `step1`. Supplementary tables S3–S5 were used in error; S6 is the
BBB-enriched table. See the [audit](audit.qmd).

Munji RN, et al. (2019).
Profiling the mouse brain endothelial transcriptome in health and disease.
*Nature Neuroscience* 22(11): 1892–1902.
: Mouse BBB-enriched genes (518) — `step1`.

Wälchli T, et al. (2024).
Single-cell atlas of the human brain vasculature.
*Nature* 614: 945–954.
: Human brain endothelial single-cell expression — `step2`, `step4b`.

Yang AC, et al. (2022).
A human brain vascular atlas reveals diverse mediators of Alzheimer's risk.
*Nature* 603: 885–892.
: Human endothelial subtype markers — `step4b`. Only the first (arterial) sheet was read.

Winkler EA, et al. (2022).
A single-cell atlas of the normal and malformed human brain vasculature.
*Science* 375(6584): eabi7377.
: Human endothelial markers — `step4b`.

## Consulted, not used

Giger T, Khaitovich P, Somel M, Lorenc A, Lizano E, Harris LW, Ryan MM, Lan M, Wayland MT,
Bahn S, Pääbo S (2010).
Evolution of neuronal and endothelial transcriptomes in primates.
*Genome Biology and Evolution*. GEO: GSE12293.
: Originally logged as the macaque dataset. The downloaded samples are all human, so it does
not supply macaque expression data. See the [audit](audit.qmd).

## Databases

Ensembl, release 113 — <https://www.ensembl.org>
: Gene IDs, orthologues (via BioMart) and coding sequences for GRCh38 (human), GRCm39 (mouse)
and Mmul_10 (macaque) — `step3`, `step3b`, `step5a`.

Human Protein Atlas, tissue RNA consensus — <https://www.proteinatlas.org>
: Tissue expression used to build the liver control set — `step4c`.

## Software

- **R** with `readr`, `dplyr`, `ggplot2`, `readxl`, `knitr`
- **Bioconductor:** `biomaRt`, `Biostrings`, `pwalign`
- **`seqinr`** — dN/dS (`kaks`)
- **Seurat** — processing the Wälchli single-cell object (`step2`)
- **Quarto** — this website
